data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), as a unit is picked for a **[fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back)**, while it is in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of one of your **WORLD EATERS CHARACTER** units.

**Target:** That same **WORLD EATERS CHARACTER** unit.

**Effect:** Whenever an enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the unit is picked for a **fall-back move**, it has to make that move in **[desperate escape](vsdata:core-rule/desperate-escape-2)** mode, and if it is **[battle-shocked](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock)**, its **[hazard rolls](vsdata:core-rule/hazard-rolls)** for the move get -1.

window.event: enemy unit selected to make a fall-back move while engaged with a friendly WORLD EATERS CHARACTER unit

effect.recipient: each enemy unit engaged with the target that is selected to make a fall-back move

detail.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: the effect has no printed duration, so it lasts for the rest of the phase it was used in.
